object.attr: stakeholder: suspect links need the full history, and a subfolder of a clone would be served without the documents beside it. Added in 0.2.0. Which folders are a repository's root is a rule shared with the GUI and mellon-check, so it is handed to STORE; a path that isn't a folder is one such case (review Q8). Exiting before the handshake keeps a client from listing tools of a server that then fails.
object.description: If the folder to serve isn't the root folder of a repository, the MCP server shall exit with status 2 without answering a Model Context Protocol message.
